_about: Every public-domain J. C. Ryle (1816-1900, Bishop of Liverpool) text the Word Hoard holds. Works published in his lifetime are public domain; posthumous printings before 1931 are PD too and are marked. Later abridgements, 'modernised' editions and reprints from 1927 on are excluded. Expository Thoughts on the Gospels (7 vols) is assembled from single volumes of different lifetime printings, each identified by the chapter range of its section headings: Matthew from CCEL, Mark, Luke 1-2, John 1-3 from Internet Archive. Ryle's compiled hymnals belong to the hymn manifest.
